talents.e: Substantially boosts damage dealt with wands.
Channeled Arcane spells resist damage interruption, including while casting Arcane Blast.
Grants armor scaling with a portion of your Intellect.
Lowers target resistances to your spells and reduces Arcane threat.
Boosts resistances, and fully resisted spells return a little mana.
Damage spells can make your next damage spell free of mana cost.
Chance to make your next Arcane Missiles free, faster and shorter.
Extends the reach of your Arcane spells.
Adds critical strike chance to all your Arcane spells.
Stacking Intellect-based spell damage, but Arcane Blast costs more mana.
Reduces mana lost to Mana Shield and boosts Mage Armor resistances.
Counterspell also silences the target for a longer duration.
Lets much more mana regeneration continue while casting.
Arcane projectile with bonus damage from your maximum mana.
Makes your next short-cast Mage spell instant, on a long cooldown.
Increases Intellect and Arcane critical strike damage bonus.
Raises spell damage and critical strike chance.
Briefly boosts all spell damage, but also raises spell mana costs.
Adds critical strike chance to Fire Blast, Ice Lance, Arcane Blast, and Scorch.
Fireball, Frostfire Bolt and Arcane Wrath cast 0.5 sec faster.
Fire critical strikes set targets burning for extra damage over time.
Extends the range of your Fire spells.
Fire spells have a chance to briefly stun the target.
Chance to keep casting when damaged, with lower Fire threat.
Adds critical strike chance to Flamestrike.
Slow, large Fire hit with a damage-over-time component.
Shorter Fire Blast cooldown and longer range.
Scorch makes targets vulnerable to Fire damage, stacking up to five times.
Fire Ward gains a chance to reflect Fire spells.
Fire crits from several spells shorten your next Pyroblast cast.
Fire and Frost critical strikes refund part of their mana cost.
Adds critical strike chance to your Fire spells.
Instant Fire blast hitting nearby enemies and slowing their movement.
Fire damage bonus scaling with Fire effects on the target.
Fire hits stack critical chance until several Fire crits land.
Boosts Frost Armor and Ice Armor, and Frost Ward may reflect Frost spells.
Shortens the cast time of Frostbolt.
2% more spell hit with Frost and Fire spells per rank.
Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Frost spells.
Chill effects have a chance to briefly freeze the target.
Shortens the cooldown of Frost Nova.
Lengthens Chill effects and slows targets further.
Reduces Frost spell mana cost and the threat they generate.
Adds a Chill effect to Blizzard that slows targets.
Instant Frost hit dealing heavy extra damage to Frozen targets.
Extends range of some Frost spells and radius of others.
Makes you immune to attacks and spells for a time, but you cannot act.
Raises critical strike chance against Frozen targets.
Increases damage dealt by Cone of Cold.
Resets cooldowns on your other Frost spells.
Chills may let your next spells treat targets as Frozen.
Frost spells stack a damage vulnerability and empower Cone of Cold.
Absorbing shield that keeps your casts from being interrupted by damage.
